title: Essex Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval a-Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Brox Industries.
petitioner: Essex Gas Company D/B/A National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. The Comnmissoners participating were: Judith F. Judson, Chairman; Commissioners; James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Brian Paul Golden, and Soo Kim. (D.T.E. 06-GC-25)
